basic_details.job_title: ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in
basic_details.short_information: One Senior Research Fellow is to be engaged under the "CRP on Maize Biofortification" project (PI: Dr. A.K. Das, Senior Scientist) at ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research (ICAR-IIMR), Ludhiana, on a contractual basis for one year, at Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month for the 1st and 2nd year. The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding or a related listed subject. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 23 November 2026 at 11 A.M. at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana, or attend online by emailing their application to [email protected] by 22 November

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is as per GOI/ICAR rules. The application form asks for age as on the closing date for receipt of applications. | The degree certificate required for the post should be in hand on the date of the walk-in interview. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

qualification.details: Master's degree in relevant subjects (Genetics & Plant Breeding/Genetics/Plant Breeding/Agricultural Botany/Seed Science and Technology) with 4 years/5 years of Bachelor's degree. Or candidates holding a three-year Bachelor's degree along with a Master's degree in the above-mentioned subject should have the NET qualification and 2 years of research experience.

how_to_apply: The notice offers two ways to take part in the interview.
Walk-in: appear before the Selection Committee on 23 November 2026 at 11 A.M. at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana.
Online: send the application along with supporting documents to [email protected] by 22 November 2026.
Prepare the application in the format printed with the notice (pages 3 and 4), mentioning the name of the position and the project name.
Sign the declaration on relatives working at ICAR-IIMR and on the truthfulness of the information.

The application format asks for: name, father's name, date of birth, full present and permanent address with telephone/mobile numbers and email address, category (General/SC/ST/OBC), qualification details with percentage marks from matriculation/high school onwards (highest qualification first), previous experience if any, publications/awards/accessions/database/general and popular articles, a self-declaration regarding truthfulness, and signature with date and place. The form allows only published research papers in journals with NAAS rating/Impact Factor under publications. A candidate can apply for one position only.
One set of attested copies of each certificate
Passport size photograph (to be pasted on the application form)
Proof of category (SC/ST/OBC/General) and proof of experience
No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for candidates already working in any project/scheme/organization
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The number of vacancies is tentative and can be increased or decreased. The Director, ICAR-IIMR, Ludhiana reserves the right to cancel or postpone the walk-in-interview. Candidates must declare whether any near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR-IIMR; non-declaration can lead to cancellation of candidature and selection. Candidature or appointment may be cancelled without notice if any information is found false or incorrect. Changes or corrigendum, if any, will be posted on the institute website, https://iimr.icar.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-IIMR
content_sections.text: ICAR - Indian Institute of Maize Research is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research located at Village Chahar, Ladhowal, Ludhiana, Punjab - 141008. The Senior Research Fellow post is under its "CRP on Maize Biofortification" project, with Dr. A.K. Das, Senior Scientist, as the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in relevant subjects (Genetics & Plant Breeding/Genetics/Plant Breeding/Agricultural Botany/Seed Science and Technology) with 4 years/5 years of Bachelor's degree. Or candidates holding a three-year Bachelor's degree along with a Master's degree in the above-mentioned subject should have the NET qualification and 2 years of research experience. Experience in Molecular Breeding, biotechnology and proficiency in computer application. Experience will be counted after acquiring the basic minimum qualifications. The application form asks for experience of one year and above only, with proof attached. The age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is as per GOI/ICAR rules. The application form asks for age as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The degree certificate required for the post should be in hand on the date of the walk-in interview. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month for the 1st and 2nd year, and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA per month for the 3rd year, as applicable under ICAR norms. The engagement is for one year and may be extended or curtailed as per need and performance. The position is purely temporary and will be filled on a contractual basis, co-terminus with the project/scheme. The selected candidate will have no right or claim for regular appointment at the Institute. The Director, ICAR-IIMR, Ludhiana reserves the right to terminate the contractual engagement even before completion of the project, and no representation in this regard will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellows
content_sections.text: The notice offers two ways to take part in the interview. Walk-in: appear before the Selection Committee on 23 November 2026 at 11 A.M. at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana. Online: send the application along with supporting documents to [email protected] by 22 November 2026. Prepare the application in the format printed with the notice (pages 3 and 4), mentioning the name of the position and the project name. Sign the declaration on relatives working at ICAR-IIMR and on the truthfulness of the information. The application format asks for: name, father's name, date of birth, full present and permanent address with telephone/mobile numbers and email address, category (General/SC/ST/OBC), qualification details with percentage marks from matriculation/high school onwards (highest qualification first), previous experience if any, publications/awards/accessions/database/general and popular articles, a self-declaration regarding truthfulness, and signature with date and place. The form allows only published research papers in journals with NAAS rating/Impact Factor under publications. A candidate can apply for one position only. Original certificates Typed bio-data One set of attested copies of each certificate Passport size photograph (to be pasted on the application form) Proof of category (SC/ST/OBC/General) and proof of experience No Objection Certificate from the present employer, for candidates already working in any project/scheme/organization

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in/online interview before the Selection Committee on 23 November 2026 at 11 A.M. Walk-in candidates report at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana, at least 30 minutes before the scheduled time to complete the necessary formalities. Ineligible candidates will not be allowed to appear for the interview, and canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-IIMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one Senior Research Fellow position under the "CRP on Maize Biofortification" project; the notice says the number of vacancies is tentative and can be increased or decreased.

faq.question: Q2. When is the ICAR-IIMR SRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in/online interview is on 23 November 2026 at 11 A.M. at ICAR-IIMR, Ladhowal Campus, Ludhiana; candidates attending online must email their application by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding/Genetics/Plant Breeding/Agricultural Botany/Seed Science and Technology with a 4-year/5-year Bachelor's degree, or a three-year Bachelor's degree plus Master's degree in these subjects with NET qualification and 2 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ICAR-IIMR SRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC as per GOI/ICAR rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month for the 1st and 2nd year and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA per month for the 3rd year, as applicable under ICAR norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ICAR-IIMR SRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is added to the Rs. 37,000/- or Rs. 42,000/- monthly emoluments, as applicable under ICAR norms; no TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the ICAR-IIMR SRF online interview?
faq.answer: Send the application in the printed format, along with supporting documents, to [email protected] by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will the ICAR-IIMR Senior Research Fellow be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in/online interview before the Selection Committee on 23 November 2026; walk-in candidates should report at least 30 minutes before 11 A.M.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICAR-IIMR SRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely temporary and contractual for one year, co-terminus with the project/scheme, and gives no right or claim for regular appointment at the Institute.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one position?
faq.answer: No, the application form states that a candidate can apply for one position only.
